races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Snowski
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer sporting first-time cheekpieces after disappointing Plumpton effort, but stable's focus appears elsewhere
runners_data.comment: Struggled when a big-priced outsider for 2m4f Plumpton maiden last month
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled when a big-priced outsider for 2m4f Plumpton maiden last month; now sports cheekpieces; stable has much more obvious chance with Cluain Chormaic.

runners_data.name: Style De Folie
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who can control the tempo, course experience valuable but Boxing Day form needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: With a good stable but managed only fifth of six in a bumper here on debut
runners_data.spotlight: With a good stable and has a good pedigree but managed only fifth of six on bumper debut here (good to soft) on Boxing Day.

runners_data.name: Jetaway Holiday
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with point-winning form, Henderson polish and Nico de Boinville booking suggest untapped potential
runners_data.comment: Point winner; made low-key rules debut in a bumper last month but is open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Joined Nicky Henderson after winning a fast-ground point last spring; made low-key rules debut when well-held fifth in Warwick bumper (good to soft) last month but ought to be capable of better.

runners_data.name: Cockney Cleopatra
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carrying 7lb penalty but proven hurdling experience and consistent finishing kick

runners_data.name: Cluain Chormaic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form, Tom Cannon booking adds tactical nous for progressive type

runners_data.name: Hardly Surprising
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with proven stamina over this trip, soft ground form excellent and Harry Fry in good form
runners_data.comment: Good third a Doncaster in January; big player if handling the quicker ground
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner (yielding ground) who was placed on the last two of his three hurdling starts, more recently when third of 13 at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in January; will be right in the thick of things if handling the drying ground.

runners_data.name: Dropematthestation
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who stays strongly, recent tongue-tie addition suggests breathing issues addressed
runners_data.comment: Weakened into third on last two hurdling starts; wind op may aid his finishing effort
runners_data.spotlight: Weakened into third on slow ground on last two hurdling starts (both 2m3f; tongue-tie added last time) but ran well for a long way in those races; no surprise if combination of last month's wind op and today's return to better ground enables a stronger finishing effort; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Mega Etoile
runners_data.note: Prominent type making hurdling debut, bumper form mixed but Henrietta Knight's horses often improve for experience
runners_data.comment: First bumper run was okay but the second was a backward step; hurdle debut today
runners_data.spotlight: Made fairly encouraging bumper debut on heavy ground in February but last month's run on good ground was a backward step; can only be watched on hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Knight Templar
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who races too freely, tendency to fade in finish makes him vulnerable in competitive field
runners_data.comment: Showed promise in Irish points last season but safely held in two maiden hurdles this year
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise in Irish points last season but was safely held in two soft-ground maiden hurdles this year (2m/2m1f; raced too freely), and was withdrawn from a race in between with good ground deemed unsuitable.

runners_data.name: Maximum Benefit
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better suited to quicker surfaces, low-grade handicaps likely ceiling
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced in two slow-ground hurdles this year but low-grade handicaps beckon
runners_data.spotlight: Not disgraced in two slow-ground hurdles this year (2m/2m1f) and could plausibly be seen to better effect on this quicker surface but low-grade handicaps are probably next on his agenda.

runners_data.name: Graeme The Grey
runners_data.note: Prominent type who showed promise in bumpers but well held on hurdling debut, significant improvement needed
runners_data.comment: Showed some promise in bumpers but was well held when fourth here on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some promise in his bumpers but was well held when fourth here (2m1f, good to soft) on recent hurdling debut and has a lot to find with the principals.

runners_data.name: Testing Patience
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with decent recent Kempton form, Gary Moore stable in good form but others preferred
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far when last of four finishers on hurdling debut but others have stronger form
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten far when last of four finishers at Kempton (2m5f, good) on last month's hurdling debut but might have been flattered by his proximity there and others here have much more convincing form.

runners_data.name: Porridge
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with shocking recent record of four consecutive pull-ups, makes no appeal whatsoever
runners_data.comment: Pulled up all four starts this season, twice off lowly marks in handicaps; makes no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up all four starts this season, twice off lowly marks in handicaps, and makes no appeal.

races.paceDynamic: Style De Folie looks the only confirmed front runner in this field and can dictate at a sensible gallop without pressure. The prominent runners Cluain Chormaic, Dropematthestation and Mega Etoile will track behind but none are aggressive pace forcers. This creates a steady tempo that builds gradually, with the real racing beginning from the second last hurdle. The lack of pace pressure and honest gallop strongly favours horses that can travel well in behind and produce a sustained finish, making this a race for hold-up performers and those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Style De Folie sets uncontested fractions and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home, with the strongest stayers prevailing in a sprint finish. Cockney Cleopatra and Hardly Surprising can use their proven finishing kicks to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Cluain Chormaic and Dropematthestation press Style De Folie from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo from three furlongs out creates a genuine test of stamina where horses positioned prominently can kick clear. Those tracking the leaders are perfectly placed to strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Henderson Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Jetaway Holiday shows significant improvement from his Warwick debut
scenarios.body: The point winner benefits from Nico de Boinville's tactical nous and the Henderson polish to produce a career-best performance. His fresh legs and undeveloped ability prove decisive in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Persists
scenarios.trigger: If Style De Folie's soft ground form translates to genuine stamina advantages
scenarios.body: The Jamie Snowden runner uses his uncontested lead to build an unassailable advantage, staying on strongly when others falter. His Boxing Day experience at the course proves invaluable in the testing conditions.

watchPoints.text: Porridge has been pulled up in all four starts this season and represents a serious danger to others if continuing poor form
Style De Folie must handle the responsibility of front running as sole pace setter against more experienced hurdlers
Jetaway Holiday's market position will reveal Henderson team's confidence in the point winner's improvement
Cluain Chormaic's early positioning crucial as Tom Cannon decides whether to track or challenge the front runner
Knight Templar's tendency to race too freely could see him weaken rapidly if attempting to track the early pace

races.name: Last Resort Club Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Northanger Abbey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with first-time tongue-tie who showed promise last time but remains a maiden over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Made quite promising handicap debut over 2m last month; moves back up in trip here
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 over hurdles but made quite promising handicap debut when sixth of 13 at Warwick (2m, good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) last month and this move back up in trip may enable improvement; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Galactic Charm
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who looked unenthusiastic last time and has become unreliable despite decent handicap mark
runners_data.comment: Looked unenthusiastic when never-dangerous fourth last time; headgear switched here
runners_data.spotlight: Well handicapped on some of last season's form but looked unenthusiastic when never-dangerous fourth at Plumpton (2m4f, good to soft) last month and has become disappointing; needs change of headgear to perk him up.

runners_data.name: Duffry Trixs
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping back in trip after struggling in longer handicaps this season
runners_data.comment: Battled well for maiden win last season; yet to match that form in handicaps this term
runners_data.spotlight: Battled well to win Taunton maiden (2m3f, good to soft) last season but has not been in the same form in any of his four handicaps this term (2m4f-3m); drops back in trip here; needs to up his game.

runners_data.name: Mammies Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing blinkers for new trainer after disappointing recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on both starts for new stable this year; blinkers given a whirl today
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner (2m3f-2m5f, good) for the O'Neill stable but well beaten on both outings for new trainer this year; wore cheekpieces last time; blinkers given a whirl here.

runners_data.name: The Secret Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 103-day break but has shown good form on similar ground

runners_data.name: Bridge
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in form after 7-length course win 12 days ago but facing 6lb rise
runners_data.comment: Returned to form and won by 7l here 12 days ago; raised 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Bounced back from a poor run and rewarded strong market support when scoring by 7l here (2m1f, good to soft) 12 days ago; 6lb rise puts him on new career-high mark but he won't mind if the ground is quicker today; respected.

runners_data.name: Herbygoesbananas
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse absent 65 days who has shown only minor promise in three hurdle starts
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner; only minor promise over hurdles so far; may improve in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Ready bumper winner in 2024; showed only minor promise in first three hurdle races, with best effort probably his sixth over C&D (soft) on second occasion, but is open to improvement on this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Tigga Time
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 40-day break who found form at seventh attempt over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Disappointed on only appearance this year but this mark is workable if he's back on song
runners_data.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at seventh attempt, at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in November; disappointed on only appearance this year (in February) but current mark ought to be workable if he's back on song.

runners_data.name: Lyle View
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 429-day absence but won stylishly last time out
runners_data.comment: Won in good style when last in action but that was in February 2025; market instructive
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed significant improvement to win in good style at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft; well backed) in February 2025, her sixth start over hurdles; could quite plausibly have more to offer but this is her first run since; market instructive.

races.paceDynamic: Tigga Time is the only confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead, with Northanger Abbey likely sitting just behind in second. The pace will be sustainable rather than testing, as no other horses show early speed to pressure the leader. With seven hold-up horses in the field, this creates a tactical race where the front pair can dictate terms and potentially steal a march on the back markers who will need to rely on finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who may find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tigga Time and Northanger Abbey are allowed to build a comfortable lead without pressure
scenarios.body: The soft ground will blunt the finishing kicks of the hold-up horses, making it difficult for them to peg back leaders who have conserved energy up front. Horses with tactical pace and early positioning will have a decisive advantage over those relying on late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves slower than expected and the ground rides faster than advertised
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will have enough left in the tank to mount telling challenges, with Bridge's recent course form and The Secret Pearl's class telling in the finish. Fresh legs will overcome early positioning disadvantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Tigga Time fails to handle the 40-day layoff or Northanger Abbey's inexperience shows under pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the middle stages, creating a sprint finish that suits horses with turn of foot rather than pure stamina. Those held up but not too far back will benefit from the tactical chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the soft ground conditions or their respective fitness concerns
scenarios.body: Lyle View's 429-day absence becomes irrelevant if others underperform, while the consistent but unfancied runners can pick up the pieces. Value will emerge from the back of the betting.

watchPoints.text: Tigga Time's fitness after 40-day layoff could see the only pace-setter weaken, creating chaos
Bridge carries 6lb penalty from recent course win which may blunt his finishing kick on soft ground
Lyle View's 429-day absence is extreme even for a horse who won well last time out
Northanger Abbey wears tongue-tie for second time after showing improvement with it fitted
The Secret Pearl returns after 103-day break but trainer Alex Hales has good recent strike rate

races.name: Southern Cranes And Access Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Maclaine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 533 days off but only 1lb higher than his emphatic Newbury win, with proven soft ground form giving confidence despite the layoff.
runners_data.comment: Absent since below-par run in October 2024 and entitled to benefit from this outing
runners_data.spotlight: Now only 1lb higher than for emphatic win at Newbury (2m6f, good to soft) in March 2024 but absent since a lesser effort the following October and entitled to benefit from this outing.

runners_data.name: Duhallow Tommy
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with four chase wins including recent Southwell success, perfectly positioned to control this race with minimal early pace pressure expected.
runners_data.comment: Four chase wins, the latest off reduced mark in February; a possible if able to dominate
runners_data.spotlight: Four chase wins, the latest from the front off reduced mark at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) in February; just a respectable third of five at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft) last month but could be hard to catch if able to dominate here.

runners_data.name: Mumford's Magic
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won well at Doncaster two starts back but looked disappointing over the marathon trip last time, needs the pace to collapse.
runners_data.comment: Well beaten over marathon trip last time but previously in good form over 2m4f/3m
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten over marathon trip last time but looked as good as ever when winning at Doncaster (3m, soft) two starts ago, and has previously run well over 2m4f; may not be favoured by the drying ground here but can feature if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.

runners_data.name: Rip Wheeler
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse described as quirky who doesn't find much when hitting the front, relies on Robert Dunne's well-timed rides and finishing kick.
runners_data.comment: Quirky customer who has won three times under well-timed Robert Dunne rides this season
runners_data.spotlight: Quirky customer who doesn't find much when striking the front but has won three times under well-timed Robert Dunne rides this season; unraced beyond about 2m4f under rules but well suited by good/good to soft ground and probably still on a workable mark.

runners_data.name: Hawaii Du Mestivel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to chases after failed efforts this year, hurdles form suggests ability but chasing record shows clear concerns.
runners_data.comment: Progressive over hurdles in 2024; missed 2025; pulled up in two chases this year
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive over hurdles in 2024, winning three times, but missed 2025 and has been pulled up in two chases this year; combination of return to better ground and first-time cheekieces might aid a revival but others in this field have much less to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Duhallow Tommy will control this race from the front with his proven lead style, likely setting a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. With only Hawaii Du Mestivel showing any prominent tendencies, there's minimal early pressure expected, allowing Duhallow Tommy to dictate terms throughout. The hold-up horses Rip Wheeler and Mumford's Magic will need to rely on their finishing kicks, while Maclaine sits prominently behind the leader. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can avoid the late traffic problems that often plague hold-up horses in small fields.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Duhallow Tommy Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Duhallow Tommy establishes an uncontested lead and maintains his rhythm
scenarios.body: He can utilize his proven front-running ability to build an insurmountable advantage, with the lack of pace pressure allowing him to save enough for the finish. Maclaine's prominent position gives him the best chance to respond if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the finish develops into a sprint
scenarios.body: Rip Wheeler and Mumford's Magic can unleash their finishing kicks with the race becoming a test of pure acceleration rather than stamina. Their ability to produce late surges becomes the decisive factor when others have conserved too much energy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maclaine Returns Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Maclaine shows no signs of his 533-day absence and travels strongly in behind Duhallow Tommy
scenarios.body: His class advantage becomes telling as he can track the leader before asserting his superior ability in the final stages. The prominent position allows him to avoid any traffic issues while capitalizing on race fitness concerns for others.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Duhallow Tommy goes too slowly early and creates a messy, stop-start gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability, potentially allowing an outsider to benefit from the chaos. Hawaii Du Mestivel's return to chasing after hurdles success could be masked by tactical confusion.

watchPoints.text: Duhallow Tommy setting too slow a pace early could negate his front-running advantage and create a sprint finish that suits the hold-up horses.
Maclaine's fitness after 533 days absence - any signs of rustiness or lack of race sharpness will be immediately apparent given his prominent racing style.
Rip Wheeler's tendency not to find much when hitting the front could be crucial if he gets first run on the leaders in the straight.
Hawaii Du Mestivel's jumping technique in his first few fences will indicate whether he can transfer his hurdles improvement back to chasing.
The pace through the middle stages - if it becomes genuinely searching it will test the stamina reserves of all runners over this extended trip.

races.name: Land & Power Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Godot
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces difficult task with small field and likely steady pace limiting opportunities to make up ground

runners_data.name: Ferret Jeeter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly placed to track Confinentic and has proven winning form this season including recent success
runners_data.comment: Three hurdles wins this season; back in this sphere after winning chase debut last month
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner this season and added to his tally on last month's chasing debut at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft), asserting on run-in to score by 5l; only 3lb higher for this return to hurdling and won't mind if the ground ends up good; sports first-time blinkers; must be considered.

runners_data.name: Confinentic
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who can control tempo unchallenged but form this season has been disappointing
runners_data.comment: Yet to hit top gear this season but his Ascot run two starts ago makes him of interest
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to hit top gear after four runs this season and was behind Ferret Jeeter when remote third at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft) last month but his fifth of 18 at Ascot (2m7f, good to soft) two starts ago came in a much stronger race than this; can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Staff Sergeant Len
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching trainers after disappointing chase debut, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Arguably showed career-best form when placed on recent stable debut a Newbury
runners_data.spotlight: Signed off for Syd Hosie with disappointing chase run in January but arguably posted career-best performance when close third of 14 over hurdles at Newbury (3m, good to soft) for new stable last month; quicker ground will also suit; respected.

runners_data.name: Vendant
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but 0-8 over hurdles record is concerning despite recent encouraging second here
runners_data.comment: 0-8 over hurdles but came second here (2m5f) recently, after a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but returned from 11-month break with fairly good second here (2m5f, good to soft; no match for winner) 12 days ago and could plausibly still have untapped potential over this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Confinentic will dictate terms from the front with Ferret Jeeter, Vendant tracking in prominent positions behind the leader. The small field and 3m2f trip suggests a measured early gallop that will build steadily, with the real race beginning after the final flight. Confinentic's lone front-running role means he can control the tempo without pressure, while the prominent runners can position ideally to strike. This measured pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and time their challenge, rather than hold-up horses who may find the pace too honest to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Confinentic maintains his lead throughout and kicks clear after the last
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader gets first run on his rivals and uses his tactical advantage to full effect. His ability to dictate tempo without early pressure proves decisive in a staying test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners close on Confinentic approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: Ferret Jeeter or Vendant can track the leader perfectly before timing their move to perfection. The measured early pace allows them to conserve energy for a strong finish that overpowers the front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway allowing closers to be competitive
scenarios.body: Staff Sergeant Len and Godot benefit from a stronger gallop that brings them into contention. Their patient tactics pay off as they pick up the pieces from runners who went too hard too early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Confinentic stops quickly and prominent runners also empty
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where early position matters less than stamina reserves. Any horse with energy left can capitalize on the leaders' demise in a tactical finish.

watchPoints.text: Confinentic may have the race sewn up if allowed to dictate an easy lead throughout
Staff Sergeant Len and Godot both need the pace to develop strongly to have any realistic chance
Ferret Jeeter's recent chasing success suggests confidence is high returning to hurdles
Vendant's hurdle record suggests she finds one too good despite often being competitive
Small field means little cover for hold-up horses if pace stays steady

races.name: Southern Contract Lifting Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Valirann Gold
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with remarkable late surge last time, 3lb rise manageable and suits good to soft going perfectly
runners_data.comment: Produced remarkable late surge to win here recently but is too inconsistent to rely upon
runners_data.spotlight: Produced remarkable late surge to snatch what had looked an unlikely victory here (2m5f, good to soft; blinkers removed) 12 days ago; recent 3lb rise is manageable but this inconsistent 9yo tends to race lazily nowadays and it's hard to predict his mood today.

runners_data.name: Gorcombe Moonshine
runners_data.note: Prominent style but limited wins, good second at Hereford last month shows current form, 21 days since last run ideal
runners_data.comment: Has modest strike-rate but gave good account last month, after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1-33 under rules but the win came here (in 2023) and he gave a good account when second from out of the weights at Hereford (2m5f, good) last month, after a break; could have a say.

runners_data.name: Kill The Groove
runners_data.note: Chasing debutant from hurdles with prominent style, cheekpieces applied and consistent frame finishes this year at Plumpton
runners_data.comment: Made the frame on all three hurdling starts this year and has possibilities on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but made the frame on all three outings this year (all over 2m at Plumpton); moves back up in trip for this chasing debut with cheekpieces (worn once) removed; seems versatile regarding ground; can feature if he gets into a good jumping rhythm.

runners_data.name: Hobie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with useful recent chase form, 21-day break since last run and handles this ground adequately

runners_data.name: Wellwillya
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with two chase wins this season, 33-day break may need time but strong track record and form figures
runners_data.comment: Dual chase winner this season; ran big race in defeat last month and this track suits well
runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner this season (2m1f/2m5f); ran big race in defeat at Exeter (2m3f, good to soft) last month and is also well suited by this track; ought to make his presence felt again.

runners_data.name: Misteroddsocks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but 11-race maiden with unconvincing fence record, recent wind operation the key question mark
runners_data.comment: Has unconvincing record over fences this season; needs recent wind op to make a difference
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden with unconvincing record over fences this season (five attempts; remote when third last time); needs recent wind op to have made a difference.

runners_data.name: Millies Mite
runners_data.note: Won this race in 2024 over course and distance, 107-day absence since pulled-up runs creates major fitness concern
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 in poor form but both her wins were gained over C&D; revival possible
runners_data.spotlight: Gained both wins over C&D on good ground, including 2024 edition of this race; absent since pulled up on consecutive outings towards end of last year but it won't be a shock if she bounces back to form; 1lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Rap Soul
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with two wins from two chase starts this year, both at Plumpton in small fields suits similar scenario
runners_data.comment: 2-2 since switched to chasing this year and could easily have more improvement to come
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in three maiden hurdles in the autumn but 2-2 since switched to handicap chases this year, with both wins gained in small fields at Plumpton (2m4f, soft/good); has a bit more on his plate today but may still have more improvement to come.

runners_data.name: Engaging Sam
runners_data.note: Chasing debutant with prominent style, first-time visor replacing cheekpieces and poor recent hurdle form concerns
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in all three hurdle races this season and 4lb wrong for this chasing debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in all three hurdle races this season and now 0-12 in that sphere; swaps usual cheekpieces for first-time visor on this chasing debut; 4lb out of the weights; difficult to enthuse over.

races.paceDynamic: Rap Soul will dictate from the front as the sole confirmed leader, but faces immediate pressure from four prominent runners (Valirann Gold, Gorcombe Moonshine, Kill The Groove, Hobie) all wanting positions close to the pace. This creates congestion in the opening stages and potential traffic problems turning for home when the field compacts. The pace will be sustainable early but quicken significantly from 3 out as the prominent brigade challenge Rap Soul. This race shape strongly favours front runners and early prominent horses who can secure clean jumping room, while hold-up horses like Wellwillya face a tactical disadvantage in a small field with limited pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Rap Soul jumps cleanly and maintains his lead without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays controlled allowing him to kick again in the straight, while prominent runners get in each other's way behind. Front running tactics prove decisive in a race where the pace doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners successfully pressure Rap Soul from early stages
scenarios.body: A fierce battle develops from 4 out between Valirann Gold, Hobie, and Gorcombe Moonshine, with form and fitness deciding the outcome. The sustained gallop suits those who can travel strongly in the leading group.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Rap Soul and the prominent brigade go too fast early in their battle for position
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable allowing Wellwillya to close from behind in typical hold-up fashion. His proven chase form and track record become decisive factors in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion leads to multiple jumping errors or interference
scenarios.body: Misteroddsocks or Engaging Sam benefit from a cleaner passage while the fancied horses make mistakes. Recent wind surgery or chasing debut tactics prove unexpectedly effective.

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Frank Stamper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong finishing kick but needs to overcome poor recent Wincanton run and find better early positioning
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite last time but has claims if judged on earlier Plumpton second
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten favourite when only seventh at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) last month and now 0-5 over hurdles but stayed on from poor position for second at Plumpton (2m, soft) two starts ago and may still have potential.

runners_data.name: Ikigai Star
runners_data.note: Prefers good ground over soft conditions and Charlie Longsdon's poor 14-day record adds concern despite three hurdle wins
runners_data.comment: Didn't run badly last month, after a break, and has become well handicapped
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner on good ground; arguably ran better than eventual 48l defeat suggests when third at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) last month, after a layoff, and has become well handicapped; could have a say if that recent outing brought him on.

runners_data.name: Calshot Spit
runners_data.note: Dual C&D winner perfectly suited to prominent tactics and quick ground conditions after heavy ground Boxing Day success
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D winner, latterly on Boxing Day; versatile ground-wise but has become inconsistent
runners_data.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, more recently when clinging on by a nose on Boxing Day (heavy ground); back on the same mark today and will also be suited by these much quicker conditions but has not fired on either outing this year.

runners_data.name: Ballylicky Bay
runners_data.note: Improving novice hurdler with lenient handicap mark making debut for in-form Kevin Pickard stable after encouraging Warwick fifth
runners_data.comment: Improved form when 200-1 fifth at Warwick last month; now makes handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Point/bumper winner; soundly beaten on first two hurdling starts but her 200-1 fifth at Warwick (2m, good to soft) last month was much better and she's open to further improvement in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Tyson
runners_data.note: Recent Newcastle winner dropping in trip but Dan Skelton's strong 14-day record and hold-up style suits this tactical race shape
runners_data.comment: Won readily when odds-on at Newcastle last week; probably still well treated under penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish 6yo; initially disappointing for new stable this year but was made odds-on favourite at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last week and won readily; drops back in trip here; probably still well treated under 7lb penalty.

runners_data.name: Jacquetta
runners_data.note: Handicap debut with generous mark despite poor hurdle form, returning after 62-day break with cheekpieces fitted
runners_data.comment: Has lowly mark for this handicap debut and good market support will make him of interest
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten on all three hurdling starts (2m1f-2m3f) but has a lowly mark for this handicap debut and good market support will bring him into the equation; sports first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Tommy Dillion
runners_data.note: Front-running veteran with solid C&D third 12 days ago but faces younger, less exposed rivals off similar mark
runners_data.comment: Ran well over C&D recently but the drying ground is not in his favour today
runners_data.spotlight: Put in pretty good front-running shift when third over C&D (good to soft) 12 days ago but he's a lot more exposed than some of these, and his two hurdling wins were gained on heavy ground.

runners_data.name: Master Dunraven
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer seeking first hurdle success but Neil Mulholland's decent 14-day form provides stable confidence
runners_data.comment: Flopped when odds-on last time and now 0-8 over hurdles but major player on January form
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat racer; flopped when odds-on at Wetherby six weeks ago and is now 0-8 over hurdles but suggested his turn might be near when keeping-on third at Plumpton (2m, soft) two starts ago, and it will be interesting to see whether his supporters wade in again here.

races.paceDynamic: Calshot Spit will set a sustainable early pace from his prominent position, with Tommy Dillion potentially tracking close behind given his front-running tendencies. The majority of the field (Frank Stamper, Ikigai Star, Ballylicky Bay, Tyson, Jacquetta, Master Dunraven) are confirmed hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear. With limited early pace pressure and a cluster of closers, this creates a tactical advantage for horses that can position closer to the pace and avoid traffic problems. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks over this shorter 2m1½f distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Advantage Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit and Tommy Dillion dictate fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the early leaders to maintain energy reserves for the finish while the hold-up brigade faces traffic and positioning issues. Calshot Spit's dual C&D success and Tommy Dillion's recent front-running third over course and distance give them tactical superiority.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses with proven class can navigate the crowded finish
scenarios.body: Tyson's recent Newcastle victory shows he has finishing pace when positioned right, while Frank Stamper's Plumpton second demonstrates he can close strongly despite poor positioning. The shorter 2m1½f distance aids their late kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If the mid-division runners avoid the early crawl and late traffic
scenarios.body: Horses that position just behind the leaders avoid both the pace-setting duties and the hold-up traffic problems. This tactical middle ground proves optimal on Fontwell's tight track with limited passing opportunities.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the improving types capitalise on lenient marks and good positioning
scenarios.body: Jacquetta's handicap debut mark looks generous despite poor hurdle form, while Ballylicky Bay's 200-1 Warwick fifth suggests rapid improvement. Light weights and low expectations can produce shock results.
